description: Title and note render in a serif face in the design but in Hanken Grotesk (sans) in code: the inbox board uses var(--font-sans) but never defines it, so the design falls back to the default serif
note: [sans-font-undefined] design-file bug: --font-sans missing from the board's token block

description: Title ink is pure black in the design (var(--color-text-primary) is undefined on the board) vs warm near-black #2E2B27 in code
note: [primary-ink-undefined] design-file bug: --color-text-primary missing from the board's token block

description: Leading glyph is the row-kind icon (window/card) in muted #8A877F in design; code always shows the agent's model logo (OpenAI mark) in lighter #A29D93
note: [glyph-model-mark] code renders ModelMark for every row

description: Orange status dot and "review" word are missing on line 2; the code renders this row as a plain completed row (no dot, no word), so the note starts at the indent instead of after the status
note: [review-status-missing] Classic InboxRow has no review state: completed rows drop the status furniture

description: Age "56m" is bright blue #3565D4 in code vs faint grey #A8A59E in design
note: [age-ramp] code colours the age of ripening rows with its age ramp

description: Rows are taller in code: line 1 is 19px and line 2 17px (line-height 1.45) vs 16px and 15px in design, so the row is 54px instead of 49px, line 2 sits 3px lower and the row overruns the 49px design frame by 5px
note: [line-height] code inherits line-height 1.45; design leaves line-height normal

description: Leading glyph sits 3px lower relative to the title (y 11 vs 8): code nudges marks down 2px to the title baseline on top of the taller line
note: [glyph-offset] rowGlyphDown translateY(2px) is a deliberate optical-baseline tweak

description: Area outside the row is white in the design artboard and the warm window background #F5F4F1 in the code harness. Not a product defect
